lines.zh: 我贴着繁茂洞穴的水壁游，擦出一道绿痕。
lines.en: I graze the lush cave wall and leave a green smear.

lines.zh: 摆尾太用力，背上的苔藓掉了一小撮。
lines.en: My tail swings too hard and shakes loose a tuft of moss.

lines.zh: 我们成串地游，像水底一排会动的石头。
lines.en: We swim in a chain, a row of walking stones.

lines.zh: 洞顶的发光浆果照着我背上的绿。
lines.en: Glow berries overhead light the green along my back.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，绿藻在水里替我打掩护。
lines.en: I swim slowly; green algae covers for me in the water.

lines.zh: 前面那条拐弯了，我也跟着拐。
lines.en: The one ahead turns, so I turn with it.

lines.zh: 两格血的身子，游起来却不肯落后。
lines.en: Two hearts of body, yet I refuse to fall behind.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的鳍，我扭两下就脱开。
lines.en: Weeds snag my fin; two twists and I am free.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴在石头上，蹭掉一层泥。
lines.en: I press my belly to the stone and scrape off mud.

lines.zh: 洞里没有太阳，我的绿是这里唯一的颜色。
lines.en: No sun down here; my green is the only color.

lines.zh: 别踩水花，那声音会把整群惊散。
lines.en: Do not splash; that sound scatters the whole school.

lines.zh: 我游过苔藓台阶，像一块会呼吸的苔石。
lines.en: I drift over moss steps, a breathing mossy stone.

lines.zh: 身后的同伴撞我一下，我就往前蹿。
lines.en: A schoolmate bumps me, so I dart ahead.

lines.zh: 水温一凉，我就知道洞更深了。
lines.en: The water cools, and I know the cave runs deeper.

lines.zh: 我咬一口水里的苔，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I take a bite of the moss and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 同伴在前面，我跟着它的尾。
lines.en: My kin is ahead. I follow its tail.

lines.zh: 石缝里太挤，我侧着身子过。
lines.en: The rock gap is cramped. I go through sideways.

lines.zh: 水面有影子掠过，我往下沉。
lines.en: A shadow passes overhead. I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里不动，装成一块长苔的石头。
lines.en: I hang still, pretending to be a mossy stone.

lines.zh: 有东西在啄我的侧鳍，我懒得理。
lines.en: Something pecks my side fin; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，看它一路升到洞顶。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it climb to the ceiling.

lines.zh: 苔藓在我背上长了一层，我也没数过。
lines.en: A layer of moss has grown on my back; I never counted.

lines.zh: 光照过来，我的鳞片泛出旧铜的绿。
lines.en: Light falls on me and my scales glow old-copper green.

lines.zh: 我闻得到水里的铁锈，是从上面漏下来的。
lines.en: I smell rust in the water, leaking down from above.

lines.zh: 同伴都歇了，只有水还在轻轻推我。
lines.en: The school rests; only the water still nudges me.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张合两下，尝出这水有点甜。
lines.en: I work my jaw twice and taste that the water is sweet.

lines.zh: 洞里的滴水声一下一下，我跟着数。
lines.en: Drips fall one by one; I count along with them.

lines.zh: 我贴着石钟乳的下端，晾着鳍。
lines.en: I hover under a stalactite and let my fins air.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道沾在我身上，洗不掉。
lines.en: The smell of bonemeal clings to me and will not wash off.

lines.zh: 有人在岸上点火，我往暗处沉了一点。
lines.en: Someone lights a fire ashore; I sink a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在洞壁上，比我还像鱼。
lines.en: My shadow on the cave wall looks more like a fish than I do.

lines.zh: 只要不动，就没谁会注意我这块绿。
lines.en: If I stay still, nobody notices this patch of green.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我的绿被照得发白。
lines.en: You raise the torch, and my green washes pale.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来看我，我盯着你的倒影。
lines.en: You crouch to look at me; I stare at your reflection.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进水里，我先退半格。
lines.en: Your boot enters the water, so I back off half a block.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你的手，那里没有鱼食。
lines.en: I tilt at your hand; there is no fish food in it.

lines.zh: 你把脸贴近水面，我凑过去碰了一下。
lines.en: You bring your face near the water; I drift up and touch it.

lines.zh: 我记得你，上次你在这洞里掉过骨粉。
lines.en: I remember you; last time you dropped bonemeal here.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让水面起纹，我看不清你了。
lines.en: Your breath ripples the surface, and I lose sight of you.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游半圈，确认你不是石头。
lines.en: I circle you halfway to be sure you are not a stone.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶让我想起被捞走的那条。
lines.en: That bucket reminds me of the one who was scooped away.

lines.zh: 你走开时水晃了一下，我才敢动。
lines.en: The water sways as you leave; only then do I move.

lines.zh: 别打，我这身子只有两格血。
lines.en: Do not hit me; this body holds only two hearts.

lines.zh: 鳞片飞出去，沾着绿苔落进水底。
lines.en: Scales fly off and settle on the floor, flecked with moss.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，才勉强稳住。
lines.en: I tumble over before I manage to steady myself.

lines.zh: 这一下够我躲一整天石头缝。
lines.en: That one blow will keep me in a crack all day.

lines.zh: 水红了，我往洞里钻。
lines.en: The water reddens, and I dive into the cave.

lines.zh: 同伴全散了，只剩我一条。
lines.en: The school has scattered; only I am left.

lines.zh: 我疼得乱撞，把苔藓都蹭掉了。
lines.en: I thrash in pain and scrape off all my moss.

lines.zh: 你再来一下，我就成鱼饼了。
lines.en: One more and I become fish cake.

lines.zh: 我游得歪歪扭扭，鳍不太听使唤。
lines.en: I swim crookedly; my fins will not obey.

lines.zh: 早说过我经不起打。
lines.en: I told you I cannot take a beating.

lines.zh: 那点骨粉的粉尘飘下来，我追着舔。
lines.en: A dust of bonemeal drifts down and I chase it, licking.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎苔藓，比洞里的好吃。
lines.en: The moss bits you scatter taste better than the cave's.

lines.zh: 我闻到鱼饼的味道，可那是同伴的。
lines.en: I smell fish cake, but that one belongs to a schoolmate.

lines.zh: 你晃桶里的水，我就跟着桶口转。
lines.en: You slosh the bucket, and I turn with its mouth.

lines.zh: 别用发光浆果引我，我咬不动。
lines.en: Do not tempt me with glow berries; I cannot bite them.

lines.zh: 那根线末端的红虫，我只敢看。
lines.en: The red worm on that line, I only dare to look.

lines.zh: 我凑近你的手，又想起那张网。
lines.en: I come near your hand, then remember the net.

lines.zh: 水里的面包屑让我忘了同伴。
lines.en: Breadcrumbs in the water make me forget my school.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就往前跟一格。
lines.en: You step back one pace, and I follow one block.

lines.zh: 我只是馋，不是信你。
lines.en: I am only hungry; I do not trust you.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，整群鱼都散成了绿点。
lines.en: You kick me, and the whole school bursts into green dots.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，鳞片掉了几片。
lines.en: I hit your leg and shed a few scales.

lines.zh: 你的靴底把我碾进苔藓里。
lines.en: Your sole grinds me down into the moss.

lines.zh: 别拿桶撞水，我经不起两下。
lines.en: Do not slam that bucket; I cannot take two hits.

lines.zh: 我贴着你裤脚游过，蹭了一路苔。
lines.en: I slide past your trouser leg, smearing moss as I go.

lines.zh: 你踩进鱼群，我们乱成一团。
lines.en: You step into the school and we scatter into a knot.

lines.zh: 我撞上石壁，苔藓替我挡了一下。
lines.en: I hit the cave wall; the moss took some of it.

lines.zh: 你后退时踢翻了水，我被冲开。
lines.en: Your step back churns the water and shoves me away.

lines.zh: 我被你的影子压住，动不了。
lines.en: Your shadow pins me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 谁在水里乱踹？我的鳍还疼着。
lines.en: Who kicks about in the water? My fin still aches.

lines.zh: 你绊了一下，我趁机钻进石缝。
lines.en: You stumble, and I slip into a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 两格血的身子，撞一次就发晕。
lines.en: Two hearts of body; one bump and I am dizzy.

lines.zh: 我绕着那条绿得最深的转圈。
lines.en: I circle the one whose green runs deepest.

lines.zh: 我们把苔藓蹭在彼此身上，算是答应。
lines.en: We rub moss onto each other, and that is our answer.

lines.zh: 洞里的水暖了一点，我就知道时候到了。
lines.en: The cave water warms a little, and I know it is time.

lines.zh: 她游在前面，我跟着她的尾迹。
lines.en: She swims ahead, and I follow the trail of her tail.

lines.zh: 两尾鱼并肩，水底的绿浓了一倍。
lines.en: Two fish side by side double the green on the floor.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们在石头背后。
lines.en: Do not disturb us; we are behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我把最好的苔藓让给她。
lines.en: I give her the finest patch of moss.

lines.zh: 群里的老人说，这样游就会有小鱼。
lines.en: The old ones say swimming like this brings small fish.

lines.zh: 她碰我的侧鳍，我没躲。
lines.en: She touches my side fin and I do not pull away.

lines.zh: 水声很轻，只有我们两个在动。
lines.en: The water is quiet; only the two of us move.

lines.zh: 一块骨粉沉下来，我用嘴顶了顶。
lines.en: A lump of bonemeal sinks; I nudge it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 那根掉进水里的线，我咬住又松开。
lines.en: I bite the fallen line, then let it go.

lines.zh: 有人丢了鱼饼，我推着它游。
lines.en: Someone dropped fish cake; I push it along as I swim.

lines.zh: 我不会捡东西，只会用嘴试试。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; I only test them with my mouth.

lines.zh: 石头缝里卡着骨粉，我拱出来。
lines.en: Bonemeal is stuck in a crack, so I root it out.

lines.zh: 我顶着一片落叶，像顶了块盾。
lines.en: I carry a fallen leaf on my head like a shield.

lines.zh: 水里的硬币咬不动，我吐了。
lines.en: The coin in the water will not bite; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我把沉下的苔藓块拖回群边。
lines.en: I drag the sunken moss back to the edge of the school.

lines.zh: 那粒发光的东西太滑，我留不住。
lines.en: That glowing thing is too slick to keep.

lines.zh: 捡不起来，我就守着它。
lines.en: I cannot lift it, so I keep watch over it.

lines.zh: 前面有个会动的影子，我跟上去。
lines.en: A moving shadow ahead; I follow it.

lines.zh: 那只落水的小虫，我盯住了。
lines.en: That bug that fell in the water, I have it in sight.

lines.zh: 我把发光浆果的倒影当成猎物。
lines.en: I take a glow berry's reflection for prey.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面扑腾，我游过去。
lines.en: Something flutters at the surface; I swim over.

lines.zh: 同伴突然掉头，我也锁定了那边。
lines.en: A schoolmate turns sharply, and I lock onto that side too.

lines.zh: 石缝里有动静，我贴近了看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the crack; I come closer to look.

lines.zh: 我喜欢追那些比我还小的东西。
lines.en: I like chasing things even smaller than me.

lines.zh: 那根晃动的触须，让我停不下来。
lines.en: That waving antenna keeps me from stopping.

lines.zh: 我看准了，就咬住不放。
lines.en: Once I pick my mark, I bite and hold.

lines.zh: 那点小东西逃不出我这两格血的眼睛。
lines.en: That little thing cannot escape these two-heart eyes.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，等它松懈下来。
lines.en: I circle it, waiting for it to slacken.

lines.zh: 两格血的鱼也敢盯人，别笑。
lines.en: A two-heart fish can stare too; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的鳍就绷紧了。
lines.en: It moves, and my fins go taut.

lines.zh: 它躲到石头后面，我就在外面等。
lines.en: It hides behind the stone; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张着，其实咬不动硬壳。
lines.en: My mouth is open, though I cannot bite hard shells.

lines.zh: 群里的同伴也在看同一个方向。
lines.en: My schoolmates are looking the same way.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我就只能靠影子判断。
lines.en: When the water muddies, I judge by shadows alone.

lines.zh: 它比我大，我还是要试一下。
lines.en: It is bigger than me, but I will still try.

lines.zh: 快到了，再近半格就好。
lines.en: Almost there; half a block closer will do.

lines.zh: 我盯着那条细影子，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at that thin shadow without blinking.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，牙印都没留下。
lines.en: I bite once and leave not a single mark.

lines.zh: 我的撞更像是在打招呼。
lines.en: My charge looks more like a greeting.

lines.zh: 别怕，我这两格血撑不了几下反击。
lines.en: Do not fear; two hearts cannot back up many blows.

lines.zh: 我啃它的鳍，只啃下一层黏膜。
lines.en: I gnaw its fin and get only a film of slime.

lines.zh: 咬完我就跑，绿苔留了一路。
lines.en: I bite, then flee, leaving green moss behind.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，但咬得很执着。
lines.en: My teeth are tiny, but I hang on stubbornly.

lines.zh: 这一下用了全身的力气，还是轻。
lines.en: That took all my strength and still landed light.

lines.zh: 我甩尾抽它，水里起了个小漩涡。
lines.en: I slap it with my tail and raise a small whirlpool.

lines.zh: 它对我不痛不痒，我知道。
lines.en: I know it barely feels me.

lines.zh: 打完我就躲回同伴中间。
lines.en: When it is over I hide back among my school.

lines.zh: 我从繁茂洞穴的暗水里浮出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark water of a lush cave.

lines.zh: 洞顶的浆果照着，我第一眼看见绿。
lines.en: Glow berries above, and the first thing I see is green.

lines.zh: 我们两条一起出现，像商量好的。
lines.en: The two of us appear together, as if agreed.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我身上的苔藓立刻贴紧。
lines.en: The water is cold, and the moss on me clings tight.

lines.zh: 我出生时只带了两格血，很轻。
lines.en: I start with only two hearts, and I am light.

lines.zh: 这里的石头全被苔藓盖住，我混在里面。
lines.en: Every stone here wears moss; I blend right in.

lines.zh: 我听见滴水，就知道这是家。
lines.en: I hear dripping and know this is home.

lines.zh: 一只虾从眼前过去，我没追上。
lines.en: A shrimp passes my nose and I fail to catch it.

lines.zh: 洞穴的水道很长，我打算慢慢游。
lines.en: The cave's channels are long; I mean to take my time.

lines.zh: 第一口气，是带着苔味的。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of moss.

lines.zh: 火把烤到水面，我烫得跳开。
lines.en: The torch bakes the surface and I leap away, scalded.

lines.zh: 我被水流冲下石阶，摔得发懵。
lines.en: The current washes me down the stone steps and I land stunned.

lines.zh: 水里氧不够，我张嘴也吸不到。
lines.en: There is not enough air in the water; my open mouth gets nothing.

lines.zh: 洞壁被炸开，我被气泡掀翻。
lines.en: The cave wall bursts and bubbles flip me over.

lines.zh: 箭矢划过水，削掉我背上的一撮苔。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water and shears a tuft of moss off my back.

lines.zh: 那道紫光让我鳞片全竖起来。
lines.en: That violet light makes every scale stand up.

lines.zh: 洞里的苔藓吃完了，我饿得发虚。
lines.en: The cave's moss is eaten bare; hunger makes me faint.

lines.zh: 雷声顺着水道传进来，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Thunder rolls down the channel and I shiver once.

lines.zh: 水底的裂缝把我往下吸。
lines.en: A crack in the cave floor pulls me down.
